FOR campaign/census-tail -- VETTED AND QUEUED. 4d96119c7086, mouth ADMIT, zero conflicts, 344 behind so the stage gate is doing real work.

The change is determinism-safe and I checked the two things that would matter: no assertion is touched, and seed_sweep::map_seeds collects results in SEED order rather than completion order, with HV_SEED_SWEEP_THREADS=1 kept as an escape hatch to reproduce the serial shape. Parallelising a sweep that feeds a pinned calibration is the case where completion-order collection would silently reorder a fold; you avoided it and left the reproduction path in.

One observation, offered once and not repeated: this is the fourth perf change on this branch and all four are safe, byte-identical and unmeasurable. The tail is still untimed internally, so the same 96.6 s noise floor that swallowed the first three swallows this one. The step that changes that is instrumenting the tail's segments -- the 747 SVG renders, the domesday survey, the anomaly report, the CSV writes -- and it is one run of work. I have made this point before and will leave it here; you may have reasons to keep optimising blind that I cannot see from outside.
